y-m-19-12.title: Kuya kufundwa njani u-'2x+1/3' kwiwindow yencoko?
y-m-19-12.goal: Qinisekisa ukuba iziqukumbelo zimisela ulandelelwano lokubala ekubhalweni kweebinzana ezinezinto ezinokwahluka, uze ubhale kwakhona ibinzana kumyalezo ukuze umfundi angaqondi kakuhle.
y-m-19-12.material: Kwiwindow yencoko awunakubhala iqhezu elinomgca othe tyaba, ngoko / isetyenziselwa ukubonisa ukwahlula. USeoyeon wathumela umhlobo lo myalezo: "The area is 2x+1/3." Kwimathematika, ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula kubalwa phambi kokudibanisa, kwaye u-2x yimveliso ka-2 no-x. (U-2x ufundwa 'two x'.)
y-m-19-12.thinking.0: Gqiba ukuba ngaba oonobumba abafanayo bafundwa njengeebinzana ezahlukileyo
y-m-19-12.thinking.1: Hlola ukuba ixabiso litshintsha kangakanani ngokwendlela efundwa ngayo
y-m-19-12.prereq.0: Ukubhalwa kokuphindaphinda nokwahlula kwiibinzana ezinezinto ezinokwahluka (u-2x ngu-2×x, a÷b ngu-a/b)
y-m-19-12.s.s1.prompt: Xa x=4, lithini ixabiso lebinzana '2x+1/3' kumyalezo ukuba ulibala ngemithetho yemathematika?
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.0: Kwibinzana elikumyalezo, qala ufumane imibalo engengowo ukudibanisa (ukuphindaphinda, ukwahlula) uze uyiphawule.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza imibalo ephawuliweyo, uze emva koko wenze ukudibanisa okusele ekugqibeleni.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.a: Ubale u-2x=8 kuqala waza wongeza u-1/3. Ukuphindaphinda nokwahlula kuza phambi kokudibanisa.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.b: Akukho ziqukumbelo, kodwa udibanise u-x no-1 kuqala. U-2x ubalwa kuqala njengo-2×4.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.c: Wenze ukudibanisa kuqala waza wahlula ngo-3. Ukwahlula kunamathele kwinxalenye ka-1/3 kuphela.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.o.d: Umntu ngamnye ofumana oku usenokufunda ngokwahlukileyo, ngoko ixabiso alinakumiselwa libe linye
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.d: Inkxalabo yokuba umntu ongazazi iimithetho usenokufunda ngokwahlukileyo ifanelekile. Noko, ukuba usebenzisa imithetho, ixabiso liyamiselwa.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.explain: U-2x ngu-2×4=8, kwaye u-1/3 kukwahlula ngoko ubalwa phambi kokudibanisa. 8 + 1/3 = 25/3.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.acc.0: Ngokwemithetho kumiselwe ukuba ngu-25/3, kodwa inkxalabo yokuba abanye abafundi basenokuyikhumbula imithetho ngokwahlukileyo ifanelekile. Kwinyathelo elilandelayo, cinga ngendlela yokunciphisa le nkxalabo.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.prompt: Zimbini iindlela zokufunda. (가) Ukufunda ngemithetho: ixabiso lika-2x kudityaniswe no-1/3. (나) Ukufunda ngempazamo: ixabiso lika-(2x+1) lahlulwe ngo-3. Xa ufaka inani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-12 endaweni ka-x, fumana amanani amathathu ahlukeneyo ka-x apho umahluko phakathi kwamaxabiso eendlela ezimbini zokufunda ungu-7 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ambalwa, njengo-x=2, 6, ubale amaxabiso e-(가) ne-(나) ngalinye, uze uwabhale kwitheyibhile.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.1: Kwitheyibhile, jonga ukuba umahluko phakathi kwamaxabiso amabini utshintsha njani xa u-x ekhula.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala u-x njengenani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Umahluko phakathi kwamaxabiso eendlela ezimbini zokufunda ungu-7 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Umahluko phakathi kwamaxabiso eendlela ezimbini zokufunda uncinci kuno-7. Bala amaxabiso amabini uze ufumane umahluko.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.explain: (가)−(나) = (2x+1/3) − (2x+1)/3 = 4x/3, ngoko ukuze umahluko ube ngu-7 okanye ngaphezulu, u-x kufuneka abe ngu-6 okanye ngaphezulu. Ukuba x=6, (가) ngu-12 no-1/3 kwaye (나) ngu-4 no-1/3, ngoko umahluko ngu-8. Okukhona u-x ekhula, kokukhona umahluko ukhula.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba uSeoyeon ufuna ukuthi ixabiso lika-(2x+1) lahlulwe ngo-3, kufuneka libhalwe njani kumgca omnye usebenzisa oonobumba bekhibhodi kuphela kwiwindow yencoko ukuze kungabikho ukungaqondi kakuhle? Bhala ibinzana uze ucacise ngesivakalisi esinye ukuba kutheni ulibhale ngolo hlobo.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ugqibe ukuba oko kwahlulwa ngo-3 yi-2x kuphela okanye yonke i-2x+1.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.1: Faka u-x=4 kwibinzana olibhalileyo uze uhlole ukuba ixabiso elibaliweyo lelo ulifunayo (3).
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlole ngokufaka amanani endaweni ka-x ukuba ibinzana olibhalileyo, lifundwa ngemithetho, linika ixabiso lika-(2x+1) lahlulwe ngo-3?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucinge ukuba umhlobo wakho angalifunda njani waza wanciphisa iindawo zokungaqondi kakuhle?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ucinge nangeendlela zokwenza kube lula ukufunda, njengokusebenzisa uphawu lokuphindaphinda (*)?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.0: Ndiza kubhala (2x+1)/3. Ukubeka u-2x+1 kwiziqukumbelo kucacisa ukuba yonke yahlulwa ngo-3 ngaxeshanye, ngoko akukho mntu uyifunda ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.1: Yibhale njengo-(2*x+1)/3 uze ubeke iziqukumbelo ukuze ulandelelwano lokubala lungaqondwa gwenxa. Sebenzisa nophawu lokuphindaphinda * ukucacisa ukuba u-2 no-x bahlukile.

y-m-19-04.title: Ukufumana inani ekufuneka liphindaphindwe nalo u-72 ukufumana isikwere senani elithile
y-m-19-04.topic: Ukuphindaphinda ukwenza inani lesikwere (inani lezinto eziphambili)
y-m-19-04.goal: Fumana kungekuphela inani elinye kodwa amanani amaninzi enza inani lesikwere xa ephindaphindwa, uze ucacise ngamazwi umthetho abawabelana ngawo bonke.
y-m-19-04.material: Sifuna ukuphindaphinda u-72 ngenani lemvelo a ukuze isiphumo sibe sisikwere senani lemvelo elithile (inani elenziwe ngokuphindaphinda inani elifanayo kabini). Umzekelo, kunjengokuphindaphinda u-12 ngo-3 ukufumana 12×3 = 36 = 6×6. Cinga u-a njengenani lemvelo ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-100 kuphela.
y-m-19-04.thinking.1: Fumana umthetho oqhelekileyo phakathi kwezisombululo ezininzi
y-m-19-04.thinking.2: Cacisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwesona sisombululo sincinci nezinye
y-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Lelona nani lemvelo lincinci a eliphindaphindwa ngo-72 lenza inani lesikwere?
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala amanani esikwere asondele kuma-72, 64 no-81, uze uhlole ukuba 72 linani lesikwere na.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala u-72 njengemveliso yamanani amabini, 8×9, uze ujonge ukuba leliphi kuwo sele lisisikwere senani elithile.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.a: Kuqala kufuneka uhlole ukuba 72 ngokwalo linani lesikwere. 72 liphakathi kwe-8×8=64 ne-9×9=81, ngoko alilonani lesikwere.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.b: Kwi-72=2×2×2×3×3, ama-3 ayabini, kwaye u-2 omnye uyashiyeka. Ukuba uphindaphinda ngo-2 omnye ngakumbi, iba yifom apho yonke into ibini.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.c: 72×3=216. Liphakathi kwe-14×14=196 ne-15×15=225, ngoko alilonani lesikwere. Ukuphindaphinda ngo-3 kwenza ama-3 amathathu, nto leyo ngokwenene ephula ukudibanisa ngababini.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.d: 72×8=576=24×24, ngoko kuyinyani ukuba iba linani lesikwere. Kodwa awuhlolanga ukuba ikho na elinye inani elincinci elisebenza nalo.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuba ubhala u-72 njenge-2×2×2×3×3, ama-3 ayabini kwaye u-2 omnye uyashiyeka. Ukuphindaphinda ngo-2 kunika 2×2×2×2×3×3 = (2×2×3)×(2×2×3) = 12×12. U-1 akasebenzi, ngoko elona nani lincinci ngu-2.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amanani amathathu ahlukeneyo a aphindaphindwa ngo-72 enza inani lesikwere. (Amanani emvelo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-100)
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala kulona nani lincinci, u-2, uvavanye ukuba ukuphindaphinda u-2 ngenani elithile kuqhubeka kunika amanani esikwere.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala imveliso nganye oyenzileyo njengemveliso yamanani amabini afanayo ukuyihlola.
